plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
sourcesImport: code and tests; the sources.item.read grant exists in production, but no deals-category source is enabled in OpenVibe.Sources (the seeded dealnews-daily is disabled), so nothing has been imported
watchNotifications: deals.watch.matched events only; OpenVibe.Network's notification consumer does not exist yet
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy deals`: unit openvibe-deals, 127.0.0.1:4840 loopback only; Network OAuth client deals and its grants exist; on 2026-09-23 /api/ready answered 200 and the production database held 0 offers. Deployed internally, not launched: openvibe.deals still serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder until a person verifies a deals source's terms and enables it in Sources
features: offers with timestamped price observations shown "as of" and stale labels
unknown prices stay unknown in pages, JSON, JSON-LD, feeds and Search
duplicate merge and unmerge without losing votes or history
watches and saved searches (deals.watch.matched events; no delivery yet)
vote abuse controls and moderation queue
server-rendered pages, feeds and sitemaps useful without JavaScript
SDK outbox events and Search index documents
